current_model_status: V6 physical fit failed; previous CAD unchanged
user_report: Both pieces get stuck on the sides of the nubs.
confirmed_gap_reference: Sideways from the left edge of the wide nub base to the inside console wall
upper_width_height_confirmation: User confirmed 7.5 mm at about 4.4 mm above the flat pad, not the crown, on 2026-11-04.
units: Raw pixels; approximate gauge-plane millimeters for traced profiles only
coordinate_convention: u follows the gauge ruler; v is the perpendicular image-plane offset. Origins arbitrary. No profile has been promoted to console X/Y/Z.
uncertainty: Raised gauge, perspective, unknown contact band and fabric pressure prevent a calibrated error bound. Direct user dimensions take priority over photograph estimates.

records.title: Across both nubs
records.interpretation: Crosswise section across both nubs. The placement establishes orientation; its exact distance above the lower crease is not recorded.
records.use: Sidewall-shape evidence for both nubs. Direct user measurements of 17 mm at the base and 7.5 mm near the upper print contact supersede the old 13.5 / 5.6 mm openings.
records.limit: User confirms 7.5 mm at about Z=4.4 mm above the flat pad, not the crown. Do not make 7.5 mm the upper opening at every position along a sloped part.

records.title: Longitudinal nub profile: long/right inferred
records.interpretation: User identifies a vertically aligned centerline capture. The broad profile is assigned to the long/right nub provisionally; the hand obscures the placement.
records.use: Independent longitudinal-shape evidence for this nub; no longer borrow the short nub profile.
records.limit: The gauge appears to end before a flat-pad baseline is captured beyond both ends. Absolute end heights and full footprint length cannot be recovered from this curve alone.

records.title: Longitudinal nub profile: short/left
records.interpretation: User identifies a vertically aligned centerline capture; placement is beside the left wall at the short nub.
records.use: Short-nub crown and distinct end-transition evidence. Keep its profile separate from N2.
records.limit: No console Y mark or flat-pad Z=0 line is marked on the photograph. Photo grid zero is not the console crease.

records.title: Lower-left corner: plan outline
records.interpretation: The gauge appears laid approximately parallel to the pad, with pins following the left perimeter and turning into the lower corner.
records.use: A plan-outline capture, materially more useful for the corner than the earlier diagonal section. Preserve the traced shape rather than assuming one circular radius.
records.limit: Exact contact height and location relative to the nub/crease are not marked. The rounded transition is partly sampled near the gauge end; its continuation along the bottom is incomplete.

records.title: Lower-left corner: second section
records.interpretation: The gauge is held at a different angle beside the lower-left corner. A curved run and an abrupt step into the lower border are visible.
records.use: Evidence for the corner/base transition and for checking a separate corner test piece.
records.limit: The section plane and contact height are not explicitly established. The abrupt step includes a border/contact change; do not turn it into a smooth corner fillet or a new floor thickness.

records.title: Left nub to wall: lower station
records.interpretation: Crosswise capture of left console wall and short nub near its lower end; user confirms 10.3 mm from the wide base edge to the inside wall.
records.use: Direct 10.3 mm side gap is authoritative. This section also shows the wall and nub as separate features.
records.limit: This is a sideways gap, not a distance from the lower console crease. The shape photo is cropped at the right edge.

records.title: Left nub to wall: upper station
records.interpretation: Crosswise capture near the upper end of the short nub; user confirms 14.7 mm from the wide base edge to the inside wall.
records.use: Direct 14.7 mm side gap is authoritative. Do not substitute a measurement from the narrow crown.
records.limit: The side gap locates the wall at this station, not the entire lower-left corner. Contact height and the precise station remain relevant to the wall blend.
